name: Disneyland Stage Door Café (Frontierland) Hand-Dipped Beer-Battered Cod Fish & Chips
searchKeywords: stage door cafe fish and chips
whyItWorks: Flaky white cod fillets inside crisp batter with steak fries—peeling off half of the fried batter and skipping lemon wedges gives you lean white fish on a steady day.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Discard the lemon wedge (citrus trigger), blot excess fryer oil with a napkin, and peel off thick batter ends.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter absorbs oil—skip the Stage Door Funnel Cake during flares
